messages.subject: Error inla.mode=experimental
parts:
The inla.mode=experimental doesn’t work for some reason.

My code:

inla.setOption(inla.mode="experimental") 

coords <- as.matrix(data2[,2:3])
coords =na.exclude(coords)

A_point <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh, loc = coords)
spde1 <- inla.spde2.matern(mesh, alpha = 2)
s.index <- inla.spde.make.index("spatial.field", n.spde = spde1$n.spde)

stack <- inla.stack(data = list(y = data2$mean), A = list(A_point),
                    effects = list(c(s.index,list(Intercept = rep(1,spde1$n.spde)))),
                   
                   
                    tag="obs")


data.inla <- inla(log(y) ~ -1 + Intercept +
                    f(spatial.field, model = spde1),
                  family='Gaussian', data = inla.stack.data(stack),
                  control.predictor = list(A = inla.stack.A(stack)),
             
                 
                  control.compute = list(cpo = T, waic=T), verbose=T)
summary(data.inla)
